passages.heading: Keep Commissioner Mike Crabb Orange County District 2
passages.text: A safer, stronger future for Northwest Orange County.

passages.heading: Endorsed by Sheriff Mina
passages.text: Commissioner Mike Crabb has earned the trust of public safety leaders because he has spent his life serving and protecting Orange County families. As a longtime deputy sheriff and public servant, Mike understands what it takes to keep communities safe and support the men and women who serve on the front lines.

passages.heading: Backed by Law Enforcement & Community Leaders
passages.text: Mike has earned the support of the organizations that know public safety, local government, and West Orange County best.

passages.heading: West Orange Political Alliance
passages.text: WOPA endorses candidates who share its commitment to responsible growth, strong communities, and effective local leadership in West Orange County.

passages.heading: Florida State Fraternal Order of Police
passages.text: The state's leading law enforcement organization stands with Mike — a proven public safety leader who will always back the badge.

passages.heading: Orange County Sheriff's FOP Lodge 93
passages.text: Mike's fellow Orange County deputies know his character and his record. Lodge 93 proudly endorses one of their own.

passages.heading: Orange County Firefighters | Local 2057
passages.text: Orange County's professional firefighters proudly stand with Mike — a leader who has always had the backs of first responders.

passages.heading: Qualified and Ready to Lead
passages.text: Mike Crabb has dedicated his life to serving Orange County. With 30 years of service as a Deputy Sheriff, experience working with Orange County mayors, and a record of solving problems for local residents, Mike is ready to bring steady, practical leadership to Orange County Commission District 2.

passages.text: Advocated for safer roads and pedestrian safety initiatives that protect families across Orange County.

passages.heading: Fiscal Responsibility
passages.text: Secured millions in grant funding, saving taxpayer dollars and stretching every public dollar further.

passages.heading: Legislative Leader
passages.text: Championed changes in state law and local policy to deliver safer streets and stronger communities.

passages.heading: Local Advocate
passages.text: Worked with FDOT and state partners so Orange County receives its fair share of resources.

passages.heading: Special Olympics Supporter
passages.text: Supports Special Olympics Florida through the Law Enforcement Torch Run year after year.

passages.heading: Rooted in Orange County
passages.text: Mike has been married 39 years to Pamela, an elementary school principal in West Orange County. They have three grown children and one granddaughter.

passages.heading: Vote November 3
passages.text: Make your plan to vote for Commissioner Mike Crabb, Orange County Commission District 2.

passages.heading: Keep Commissioner Mike Crabb
passages.text: Mike is running to bring experienced, common-sense leadership to Orange County Commission District 2. Your support will help us reach voters across Northwest Orange County.

passages.heading: A Stronger Northwest Orange County
passages.text: Practical priorities for the families, neighborhoods, and small businesses of District 2.

passages.heading: Economic Affordability
passages.text: Mike will work to tackle housing costs, reduce taxes, and attract high-paying jobs so families can afford to live, work, and thrive in Northwest Orange County.

passages.heading: Reduced Traffic Congestion & Enhanced Transportation
passages.text: Mike supports faster implementation of technology to improve traffic flow, strengthen connectivity, and expand transportation options for residents.

passages.heading: Crime Prevention & Public Safety First
passages.text: As a deputy sheriff with decades of experience, Mike understands that safe communities are the foundation of a strong quality of life. He will support first responders and work to ensure public safety remains a top priority.

passages.heading: Smart, Responsible Growth
passages.text: Mike believes growth must be managed responsibly. Development should meet the needs of residents, protect existing neighborhoods, improve infrastructure, and pay for itself.

passages.heading: Parks & Environmental Conservation
passages.text: Mike will work to protect wildlife, preserve natural resources, and secure grants to convert aging septic systems that are leaking into our watershed.

passages.heading: Where does Mike Crabb stand on economic affordability?
passages.text: Mike Crabb works to make Northwest Orange County more affordable for families by tackling housing costs, reducing taxes, and attracting high-paying jobs.

passages.heading: Where does Mike Crabb stand on traffic and transportation?
passages.text: Mike Crabb supports reducing traffic congestion with better roads, smarter traffic technology, and more transportation options across District 2.

passages.heading: Where does Mike Crabb stand on public safety?
passages.text: Mike Crabb supports law enforcement, crime prevention, and safe neighborhoods, drawing on 30 years as an Orange County deputy sheriff.

passages.heading: Where does Mike Crabb stand on growth?
passages.text: Mike Crabb supports smart, responsible growth that protects existing neighborhoods and pays for the infrastructure it requires.

passages.heading: Where does Mike Crabb stand on parks and the environment?
passages.text: Mike Crabb supports protecting the parks, wildlife, watershed, and natural places of District 2 for future generations.

passages.heading: Meet Commissioner Mike Crabb
passages.text: Commissioner Mike Crabb has spent his life serving Orange County. He was appointed and sworn in on August 25, 2026 to the Orange County Board of County Commissioners, representing District 2. From 30 years patrolling and protecting our community as a Deputy Sheriff, to advising two Orange County Mayors, to building a small business right here at home, Mike's record is one of steady service, practical problem solving, and dedication to the people of Northwest Orange County.

passages.heading: Meet Commissioner Mike Crabb
passages.text: As Orange County Commissioner for District 2, Mike is focused on what matters most to local families: safe neighborhoods, affordable living, responsible growth, better traffic, and protecting the parks and natural places that make our community special.
